ERRORS.PROPERTY_OWNER_REQUIRED: At least one owner is required.
ERRORS.PROPERTY_OWNER_ATTACHMENT_REQUIRED: At least one owner ownership/license attachment is required.
ERRORS.TENANT_ASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED: Tenant must be assigned to a unit or a property.
ERRORS.LEASE_PERIOD_REQUIRED: Lease start and end dates are required.
ERRORS.LEASE_PERIOD_INVALID: Lease end date must be on or after lease start date.
ERRORS.LEASE_ATTACHMENT_REQUIRED: At least one lease contract attachment is required.
ERRORS.DAMAGES_AMOUNT_REQUIRED: Damages amount is required when damages are reported.
ERRORS.RENEWAL_DATE_INVALID: Proposed end date must be after proposed start date.
ERRORS.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: This file format is not supported. Allowed: common images (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF, HEIC, JFIF, …) and PDF/Word documents.
